title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Master cassette -> metal cassette x 2 -> CD-R (Sony TC-K717ES -> Marantz CDR500) -> Audacity -> AIFF -> FLAC Pitch adjusted - 1% to match patch source
source: FOB audience recording, taper and equipment unknown

ai_review.summary: Excellent outdoor audience recording captures a high‑energy Ventura show with standout versions of Loser, Ship of Fools, Crazy Fingers and a blazing Not Fade Away→The Other One sequence.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this Ventura performance as one of the best they’ve heard, highlighting Jerry Garcia’s soaring guitar work through a psychedelic second set that rolls from Not Fade Away into The Other One and Wharf Rat. The audience tape is praised for its clarity—thanks to the outdoor setting and careful restoration—and even a patch in “Ramble On Rose” has been fixed. Overall the show feels vibrant and spiritually resonant.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing 5‑star comments about both performance and recording; three detailed positive reviews plus two neutral/zero‑star notes give a strong indication of high quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Outdoor audience tape noted as very clear with no room echo; restored by LMA and includes a patch for 'Ramble On Rose'. No major drop‑outs or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set highlighted by Loser, followed by an epic second‑set psychedelic flow that blends space into Not Fade Away → The Other One and climaxes with Wharf Rat.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Garcia’s guitar—calling it ‘speaking’, noting genius licks throughout the NFA→Other One suite.
